name: inbox
description: The repo's inbox/ work queue as a pane: todo items at the root, then processing/, review/, done/ and blocked/. Shows what is ready (dependencies, owner-path overlap, locks), starts Codex or Claude workers on items, drains the queue, reviews and accepts, with a watchdog for idle workers and cross-session locks

idleMinutes.title: Idle minutes
idleMinutes.description: A worker with no new activity for this long turns yellow and toasts once.

timeoutMinutes.title: Timeout minutes
timeoutMinutes.description: A worker idle this long is marked timed out (red, toast once), then the on-timeout action runs.

maxRunMinutes.title: Max run minutes
maxRunMinutes.description: Optional wall-clock cap, treated like a timeout. 0 turns it off.

onTimeout.title: On timeout
onTimeout.description: mark: only the row and a toast. nudge: also send the worker a note. redeploy: send the item back to todo and dispatch a fresh worker (once per item). The mod cannot stop a subagent.

lockStaleMinutes.title: Lock stale minutes
lockStaleMinutes.description: A lock not refreshed for this long can be taken over by another session.

commitTrailer.title: Commit trailer
commitTrailer.description: Git trailer key a review commit carries, followed by the item name; the commit check looks for it.

autoReview.title: Auto review
autoReview.description: When a worker lands an item in review/, start a reviewer on it at once (it verifies, commits with the Inbox trailer and moves the item to done/, or sends it back). While draining, items already in review/ get reviewers too, within the drain width. Each item is auto-reviewed once per session.

codexModel.title: Codex model
codexModel.description: Model line passed to the codex-runner for Codex items. Empty uses the runner's default (gpt-6.1-sol, or CODEX_UI_MODEL).
